title: Seoul’s deal with Trump now hinges on two powers in Washington
caption:
South Korea's massive $350 billion agreement with the US is hitting a wall. With a new Congress in power, the path to nuclear cooperation and security transfers has become significantly more complicated.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul’s deal with Trump now hinges on two powers in Washington
